# superset_report (Resource)

Manages a report or an alert of the Alerts & Reports page: a chart or a dashboard sent to recipients on a schedule, or, for an alert, when a SQL query meets a condition. The `ALERT_REPORTS` feature flag must be on, and Superset needs its workers to actually send anything.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# A dashboard sent every Monday morning as a PNG.
resource "superset_report" "weekly_sales" {
  name         = "Weekly sales"
  type         = "Report"
  crontab      = "0 9 * * 1"
  timezone     = "Europe/Berlin"
  dashboard_id = superset_dashboard.sales.id
  description  = "Sales of the past week"

  recipients = [
    { type = "Email", target = "sales@example.com, management@example.com" },
    { type = "Slack", target = "#sales" },
  ]
}

# An alert that sends the chart when the query returns a value below the threshold.
resource "superset_report" "low_sales" {
  name                = "Low sales"
  type                = "Alert"
  crontab             = "0 * * * *"
  chart_id            = superset_chart.sales_today.id
  report_format       = "TEXT"
  database_name       = superset_database.warehouse.connection_name
  sql                 = "SELECT sum(amount) FROM sales WHERE sold_at >= current_date"
  validator_type      = "operator"
  validator_op        = "<"
  validator_threshold = 1000
  grace_period        = 3600

  recipients = [
    { type = "Email", target = "ops@example.com" },
  ]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `crontab` (String) Schedule as a cron expression, for example `0 9 * * 1` for every Monday at 09:00.
- `name` (String) Name of the report, unique among the reports or among the alerts.
- `recipients` (Attributes Set) Destinations of the report, at least one. Superset 3.1 ignores an empty list, so the recipients can only be replaced, not all removed. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--recipients))
- `type` (String) `Report` sends the content on every run; `Alert` runs the SQL query and sends the content when the condition is met.

### Optional

- `active` (Boolean) Whether the schedule runs. Defaults to `true`.
- `chart_id` (Number) Identifier of the chart to send. Set either `chart_id` or `dashboard_id`.
- `context_markdown` (String) Markdown text sent with the content.
- `custom_width` (Number) Width in pixels of the screenshot of the content.
- `dashboard_id` (Number) Identifier of the dashboard to send. Set either `chart_id` or `dashboard_id`.
- `database_name` (String) Name of the database connection an alert runs its query on. Alerts only.
- `description` (String) Free-text description of the report.
- `email_subject` (String) Subject of the email, on recent versions of Superset.
- `extra` (String) JSON document with extra settings, such as the tabs of a dashboard to send: `{"dashboard": {"activeTabs": ["TAB-id"]}}`.
- `force_screenshot` (Boolean) Whether the screenshot is always taken fresh instead of served from the cache. Defaults to `false`.
- `grace_period` (Number) Seconds during which an alert that was already sent is not sent again. Defaults to the value Superset picks, usually 14400.
- `log_retention` (Number) Days the execution logs are kept. Defaults to the value Superset picks, usually 90.
- `owners` (Set of Number) Identifiers of the users who own the report. Defaults to the user the provider authenticates as.
- `report_format` (String) Format of the content: `PNG`, `CSV`, `TEXT`, or `PDF` on recent versions of Superset. Defaults to `PNG`.
- `sql` (String) SQL query of an alert, which must return a single value. Alerts only.
- `timezone` (String) Time zone of the schedule, for example `Europe/Berlin`. Defaults to the one Superset picks, usually `UTC`.
- `validator_op` (String) Comparison of the `operator` condition: `<`, `<=`, `>`, `>=`, `==` or `!=`.
- `validator_threshold` (Number) Value the result of the query is compared with by the `operator` condition.
- `validator_type` (String) Condition of an alert: `not null` triggers when the query returns a value, `operator` compares it with `validator_threshold`. Alerts only.
- `working_timeout` (Number) Seconds a run may take before it is marked as failed. Defaults to the value Superset picks, usually 3600.

### Read-Only

- `id` (Number) Numeric identifier of the report.

<a id="nestedatt--recipients"></a>
### Nested Schema for `recipients`

Required:

- `target` (String) Addresses separated by commas, a Slack channel, or a webhook URL.
- `type` (String) `Email` or `Slack`; recent versions of Superset also take `SlackV2` and `Webhook`.

Optional:

- `bcc` (String) Addresses in blind copy of an email, on recent versions of Superset.
- `cc` (String) Addresses in copy of an email, on recent versions of Superset.
